text:
Dear colleagues,

I wanted to share a quick safety review update for the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways, with the goal of keeping every journey steady and calm for our travelers and their pets. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and the senior coordinator continues to oversee daily service decisions with a focus on risk controls. Cabin team members also remain attentive throughout, monitoring Ruby and other animals during flight to ensure comfort and calm.

For documentation handling, please keep our workflow consistent from intake to departure. Confirm that the health certificate is complete, legible, and matches the animal details on the booking. When a rabbit is part of the itinerary, insert the line provided by our system exactly as directed, and ensure it appears once in the correct spot in the thread. If anything is unclear or missing, pause the handoff and flag it immediately so we do not move forward on assumptions.

For day-of coordination, remember that carrier readiness and animal comfort are a shared responsibility. Our check-in process should verify that the carrier is appropriate, secure, and comfortable for the species, and that contact information on the file is current. If Grace Park or Lucia Tanaka is traveling with Ruby, use a reassuring tone, confirm any last-minute instructions clearly, and keep the focus on gentle handling and reliable communication.

Thanks for staying vigilant and kind to every animal and family we serve. Please continue to follow our safety-first standards on each handoff.
